# 90. Subsets II

## Solution 1

```python
class Solution(object):
    def subsetsWithDup(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: List[List[int]]
        """
        ans = [[]]
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            ans.extend([t + [nums[i]] for t in ans \
                        if t.count(nums[i]) == nums[:i].count(nums[i])])
        return ans
```
